source.title: Irish News, 7 June 1952, p. 5 ("Rural council election results"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Strabane rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Four divisions were contested: Ballyfatton, Cullion, Douglas and Sion. The other twenty-four councillors were returned unopposed (Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1952, p. 3, which prints the full list of nominations; labels as printed). Nationalist gain; Mehaffy was the outgoing councillor.
